policy.note: Asked once on first run (FEAT-001). No design tool holds these screens and the repo (shadcn/ui + tokens) is the design surface; screens are specified code-native in each feature's ui-design.md. Overridable per screen; switch to generate/register by connecting a design-tool MCP and re-running (re-verification registers tool designs after the fact).

SCR-WEB-002.name: Verify Email — Notice
SCR-WEB-002.notes: Arrival (default) state binds to POST /auth/register (201). The Resend control binds to POST /auth/verify/resend (FEAT-002); resend-sent renders the neutral 200. The rate-limited state is reinterpreted by FEAT-002 as a CLIENT-SIDE cooldown (RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS), not a server-throttle response — the resend contract is neutral (technical-design D3/D4), so the UI must not infer throttling from the response. See features/FEAT-002-verify-email/ui-design.md#scr-web-002--verify-email--notice-resend-binding-completed.

corrections: rate-limited state re-bound to a client-side cooldown to conform to FEAT-002's neutral resend contract (no server 429)

SCR-WEB-003.name: Verify Email — Result
SCR-WEB-003.notes: New web route /verify — target of the email verification link (${PUBLIC_APP_URL}/verify?token=…, FEAT-007 forward path). success routes to SCR-WEB-004 (FEAT-003). expired/invalid carry an email recovery form binding POST /auth/verify/resend; invalid folds in the already-verified case (UC-002 exc-3a) per technical-design D2.

SCR-WEB-004.name: Sign In
SCR-WEB-004.notes: Public auth zone, reusing the shared auth layout (centered 400px card + wordmark) from FEAT-001. 'error' folds the four designed login responses: 401 invalid_credentials (generic, no field highlight — no enumeration, FR-AUTH-010), 423 account_locked (FR-AUTH-019), 429 rate_limited (FR-AUTH-018), 400 validation_failed. 'unverified-prompt' is the 403 email_not_verified branch (FR-AUTH-007), reusing FEAT-002's POST /auth/verify/resend + client cooldown. Success (200) sets the session cookie via the web BFF (technical-design D6) and routes into the app-shell SCR-WEB-007.

SCR-WEB-005.name: Forgot Password
SCR-WEB-005.notes: Public auth zone (AuthShell). Served at /reset-password with no ?token=. Response is always the neutral 200 reset_requested; the 'submitted' state shows the same confirmation whether or not the email is registered (FR-AUTH-012, no enumeration). Shares the /reset-password route with SCR-WEB-006 (token-presence switch, ui-design D1).

SCR-WEB-006.name: Reset Password
SCR-WEB-006.notes: Public auth zone (AuthShell). Served at /reset-password?token=… (the worker-fixed reset-email link target). success reflects FR-AUTH-017 (other sessions signed out) and routes to /signin; invalid/expired map 400 token_invalid/token_expired with a 'request a new link' path; field-error is the 400 validation_failed password-policy case with the token NOT consumed (retry-friendly, technical-design D3).

SCR-WEB-007.name: App Shell — sign-out control
SCR-WEB-007.notes: Scoped to the sign-out control FEAT-004 adds to the app shell (sidebar-footer button-tertiary + Lucide LogOut → POST /api/auth/logout → redirect /signin). The shell FRAME and its loading/ready states are the foundations skeleton (apps/web/src/app/page.tsx), not designed by this entry; later shell-touching features (sidebar lists FEAT-009, smart views FEAT-016, settings link SCR-WEB-014) extend this entry. Logout is idempotent so the control has no error state (technical-design D1). SCR-WEB-010's UC-004 tag is a likely source typo — no entry created for it (see feature ui-design.md §escalations). FEAT-006 extends this entry with the sidebar 'Settings' sidebar-nav-item → /settings/security (SCR-WEB-014), realized text-only for the same reason the sign-out control is (no icon library wired); see features/FEAT-006-change-password/ui-design.md D2.

SCR-WEB-014.name: Settings — Security & Account
SCR-WEB-014.notes: Authenticated settings zone (app shell), served at /settings/security; reached from the new sidebar 'Settings' nav item (SCR-WEB-007 entry extended). Pure navigation hub — consumes no endpoint, so no loading/empty/error states apply (not gaps); an unresolved session redirects to /signin server-side (ui-design D4). Renders one list-row today (Change password → SCR-WEB-015); Export data (SCR-WEB-016, FEAT-017) and Delete account (SCR-WEB-017, FEAT-018) add rows to this same entry later.

SCR-WEB-015.name: Change Password
SCR-WEB-015.notes: Authenticated settings zone, served at /settings/security/password — the first guarded form. 'error' covers three server failures on one screen: 400 current_password_invalid on the currentPassword field (UC-006 alt 3a), 400 validation_failed on newPassword (policy, alt 3b), and 429 rate_limited as a form-level alert; typed input is preserved in all three (NFR-REL-004). 'success' keeps the user signed in on the rotated cookie and names the FR-AUTH-017 consequence (other devices signed out) — no bounce to /signin (ui-design D3). 'unauthenticated' is a supplementary state beyond the inventory's three: a 401 on submit routes to /signin (ui-design D4).
